text:
evan: Following up from the DR postmortem — consolidating concrete owners for regional failover, backups verification, and the upcoming game-day rehearsal. I'm creating a single thread so trackers don't get stale.

ev an: Key gaps I saw: (1) ambiguous table-level restore steps in runbook, (2) DNS + BGP failover sequencing without capacity guard, (3) no automated checksum-based backup validation, (4) game-day comms + observer roles.

mira: I'll take the table-level runbook edits. I'll add exact pg_restore flags, expected durations, and a short rollback note. Will include example `pg_restore --data-only -t orders -d staging -j4 --no-owner`. Due: 1820180000.

kishore: I'll own the DNS+BGP failover playbook. Plan: weighted DNS canary (5->25->100), BGP preference test, and a pre-failover capacity check (CPU < 70% AND free_gpu_slots >= 2). If check fails, abort and escalate. ETA: 1820250000.

ops-bot: backup-validator last_full=1820100000 last_verify=1820110000 status=partial missing=eu-west-2

mira: For table restores I'll add a section for FK order, a `BEGIN;` wrapper, and a post-restore verify query: `SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at > now() - interval '1 day';`.

kishore: Also adding a cooling lock so we don't attempt more than one region failover within 10 minutes. Will add a revert path that re-weights DNS and withdraws BGP announcements.

security-team: Heads-up: dry-restores into staging must include PII masking. Mira, Kishore — include scrub steps in PR and request a security review. We can issue short-lived scoped creds once PR is approved.

sylvie: I'll prototype the automated backup validation pipeline. Plan: weekly dry-restore of critical tables to a read-only namespace, run checksum diffs, emit Prom metrics `backup_validation_failures_total` and upload artifacts to s3://redwood-artifacts/dr-validate/. ETA: 1820205000.

ops-bot: scheduled_job: backup-dry-restore next_run=1820183600

mira: ACK owning "table-level runbook edits" due_ts=1820180000

kishore: ACK owning "DNS+BGP failover playbook" due_ts=1820250000

sylvie: ACK owning "backup validation pipeline" due_ts=1820205000

ev an: Game-day: proposing a 90-minute rehearsal with DB (mira), routing (kishore), backups (sylvie), comms (product oncall). Tentative date: 1820300000. Volunteers?

mira: I can run table restores and measure RTO.

kishore: I'll run the routing canary and be on call for rollback.

sylvie: I'll run the dry-restore and present validation report.

ev an: Great. I've put these rows into the tracker: https://redwood.internal/incidents/dr-postmortem-followups-2026 — please comment on your row to ACK so I can flip status to "in progress".

security-team: Reminder: artifact retention for validation reports should be 90 days and enable MFA-delete on the artifact bucket.

ops-bot: reminder: grant-ticket created for short-lived KMS access for dry-restore (ticket=INC-4821)

mira: small blocker — need CI runner KMS bind to decrypt snapshots for the restore test. @security-team can you expedite after PR review?

security-team: We'll prioritize the review once PR contains scrub script and IAM least-privilege doc.

ev an: Thanks all. Please update the tracker as PRs land. If anyone hits access blockers ping #eng-infra or reply here. Reopening this thread only if owners change. :white_check_mark:
